description: Named the fifty and said nothing was bought.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Held the songs and sent Nick to eat.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Kept the eight shillings visible and unpaid.
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Itemised the two unpaid sums and named no share.
name: John Heminges

description: Reported the Wednesday stair and brought no figure.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Reported the breath, did not speak the speech, and went to eat.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Asked for the old cues and left the seventeen days where they were.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Kept his name off the page.
name: Will Kemp
